finding.title: Scope DAO id-based get/update/delete methods to profileId — goal_dao, bookmark_dao, learning_order_dao, stage_dao, and BaseDao.getById all mutate by bare row id

evidence.quote:
Future<Row?> getById(int id) {
    final query = select(table)..where((t) => idColumn(t).equals(id))
**Enforcement:** `make audit` flags any user-DB table without a `profileId` column.

finding.why: Every table these DAOs sit on (curriculum_tracks, bookmarks, goals, learning_order, stage_definitions, …) declares profileId only in a secondary `uniqueKeys`/`@TableIndex`, not in Drift's actual `primaryKey` — the real PK is a bare autoincrement `id` (verified directly in lib/core/database/tables/*.dart). docs/coding-standards.md:663-665 names this an explicit invariant ("No user-facing Drift table may use a single-column autoincrement primary key without also specifying profileId as part of a composite key override") and claims it is enforced by `make audit`; the learning_tracker/Makefile audit target (22 numbered greps, lines 277-505) has no such check — the claim is false. Because the PK is bare id, `getById`/`update…().replace()`/`delete…(id)` never filter by profileId, so any caller that obtains a foreign profile's numeric id (stale provider state after a profile switch, a sync-merge bug, a crafted id) can read/overwrite/delete another profile's row. This is not theoretical: lib/features/scheduler/data/repositories/goal_repository_impl.dart's updateGoal/deleteGoal fetch `goalDao.getGoalById(goalId)` and then unconditionally mutate/delete without ever comparing `existing.profileId` to the repository's own bound profile — the DAO provides zero defense-in-depth and this caller adds none either. (Contrast: bookmark_repository_impl.setBookmark re-derives the id via a profileId-checked lookup first, so it's safe — the inconsistency across callers is exactly what a shared, enforced invariant is supposed to prevent.)
finding.recommendation: Add profileId as an explicit parameter to every id-based get/update/delete DAO method in this batch (or drop BaseDao.getById/replace-by-id entirely in favor of profileId-qualified variants) and filter the WHERE/replace target on it. Fix or remove the false claim at docs/coding-standards.md:689, and either wire a real Rule-0 check (a grep over lib/core/database/tables/*.dart primaryKey declarations, or a lint over DAO WHERE clauses) into `make audit`, or downgrade the doc's [E] tag to [P].
acceptance_criteria: A new test (e.g. in goal_dao_test.dart / bookmark_dao_test.dart / stage_dao_test.dart) creates two profiles, inserts a row for profile A, calls the DAO's update/delete method with profile A's row id from a profile-B context, and asserts the row is unchanged / the call is rejected.

goal_repository_impl.updateGoal/deleteGoal (and any other caller found via `grep -rn 'DaoBaseDao\|getGoalById\|getBookmarkById\|getLearningOrderById\|getStageDefinitionById'`) verify existing.profileId against the caller's bound profile before mutating.
docs/coding-standards.md:689 either matches a real `make audit` check or is corrected to state the gap.
